purpose: Whole-library source coverage support; no runtime dispatcher or acceptance certificate
scope: Frozen classes include nonfactory base/generic classes; reviewed extensions are separate; total is source rows, not supported hardware count
method: Read actual selector statements with a restricted source-expression parser, conditional on the explicitly listed family. No compiler, product consumer, fixture or device execution. nativeResolverMentionsClass is textual reference only and does not prove DMI reaches that class.
identityProjectionMeaning: Native OEM source-class relationship only. Preserve frozen identities, fan dispatch, CPU/board motion matrices and actual physical-provider admission. inputHidKey is metadata, not a VID/PID or protocol probe.

currentConsumerCapture.scope: OneXPlayerApex OEM current derived facts only; source declaration and live acceptance remain separate

historicalSourcePins.disposition: Top-level sourcePins, selectorAnchors and capturedAt are the preserved historical document snapshot; none is rehashed or promoted to current PASS by this bounded patch.

currentConsumerCapture.sourceMeaning: OEMChords.Clear in the HC source clears keyboard chord declarations; it does not remove the inherited native vendor-reader L4/R4 entries. Existing action IDs, device declarationSource and frozen source identity are preserved.
currentConsumerCapture.physicalCountMeaning: The six dedicated operations project to three physical dedicated keys; combination/long-press operations add no physical key. The two rear keys are separate. The existing UI uses physicalKeyIds or falls back to [keyId], so do not count eight operations as eight physical keys.
